ours.summary: Warm, well-branded shop-front ad, but floating and duplicated bouquets seriously undermine the central handoff.

must_haves.item: The florist opens at dawn, arranges a bouquet, then hands it to a smiling customer at the door.
must_haves.why: The opening, bouquet preparation and smiling doorway handoff appear in the required order. However, dawn is only suggested by the warm light, and preparation shows mainly wrapping rather than arranging.

must_haves.item: The florist, customer and bouquet stay the same; no extra or floating bouquets.
must_haves.why: The florist and customer remain consistent, but the bouquet visibly floats unsupported at 7 seconds. At 9 seconds, a second bouquet appears between the customer and the florist while she holds another.
Soft, warm sunlight gives the storefront, people and bouquet a consistent natural look.

must_haves.item: Ends on the shop front, with the name exactly "Petal & Stem" if shown.
must_haves.why: The final supplied frame clearly shows the shop front with the correctly spelled, legible sign "Petal & Stem".
The supplied timing describes a 16-second ad, and the frames are widescreen 16:9.

mcp.summary: Warm, coherent ad with the requested story and a strong final storefront shot, but the opening shop sign misspells the brand.

must_haves.item: The florist opens at dawn, arranges a bouquet, then hands it to a smiling customer at the door.
must_haves.why: The opening, bouquet preparation and smiling doorway handoff appear in the correct order; low, warm exterior light plausibly establishes dawn.

must_haves.item: The florist, customer and bouquet remain consistent, with no extra or floating bouquets.
must_haves.why: The florist and customer remain visually consistent. A single brown-paper-wrapped pink-and-white bouquet is prepared and handed over, with no evident duplicate or floating bouquet.
Warm sunlight consistently illuminates the storefront, flowers and doorway exchange.

must_haves.item: Ends on the shop front; any shown sign reads exactly "Petal & Stem".
must_haves.why: The final shot shows the storefront with the correct name, "Petal & Stem", but the opening sign appears to read "Peal & Sten", violating exact brand spelling.
The supplied sequence is identified as 16 seconds, and the frames are widescreen 16:9.

pair.why:
The first delivers a warmer, more polished opening–arranging–handoff story and ends on a clear, correctly branded shop front.
The second has conspicuous floating/duplicated bouquet artifacts that undermine the handoff and the shop’s credibility.
